$comment: Machine requirements for search-mcp. Single owner: src/requirements.ts reads this file for `providers {action:"doctor"}` and install.sh reads the same file with jq for `list`. Nothing here installs anything; each entry names the exact command and the package manager it needs, so the doctor can tell 'missing but installable here' from 'cannot be installed on this machine'. `check` is the binary looked up on PATH; `manager` is the binary that would install it; `required` marks the ones the basic chains need; `auth: true` means the binary can exist without a working subscription.

binaries.what: ripgrep — lexical floor of every chain (text, structure, semantic, crossrepo)
filename search (files, docs); falls back to the vendored ~/.pi/agent/bin/fd
macOS Spotlight CLI — machine-wide filename search (built into macOS)
cross-repo trigram index; disabled by default
